title: Ami, Father of Shmuel bar Ami
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Hyman cites [Pesachim 16b](https://www.sefaria.org/Pesachim.16b.1), which names Rav Shmuel bar Ami. In [Jerusalem Talmud Yevamot 10:6](https://www.sefaria.org/Jerusalem_Talmud_Yevamot.10.6.6) the father speaks in Rav Yehudah’s name. Hyman proposes the same reading in [Bava Kamma 9:2](https://www.sefaria.org/Jerusalem_Talmud_Bava_Kamma.9.2.2), where he reports the printed reading “Abaye of Shmuel bar Ami”; it should read “Ami, father of Shmuel, said in the name of Rav Yehudah.”[^1]

notes.text: The linked Pesachim names Rav Shmuel bar Ami. In the linked Yerushalmi, Yevamot names Immi, father of Shmuel bar Immi, and Bava Kamma gives only the father of Shmuel bar Immi. Both have the father speak in the name of Rav Yehudah. [Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=578&lang=en) has Ami as his headword and also cites Yevamot, with a different halakhah number.
